{"message": "Fixed the buffer size validation defect in `json_unescape_string()` and `decode_string_buf()` in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/lib/utils/json.c`.

### Cause
`decode_string_buf()` truncated the source length to `size - 1` when `escaped_len >= size`, but then checked `if (escaped_len > size)` instead of checking whether the unescaped string exceeded the destination buffer capacity (`size - 1` characters plus the null terminator). When `escaped_len == size` (such as a 10-character string into a 10-byte buffer in `test_json_string_array_max`), truncation occurred silently without returning `-EINVAL`.

### Solution
- Updated `decode_string_buf()` to pass the full `escaped_len` to `json_unescape_string()`.
- Updated `json_unescape_string()` to validate `dst_size > 0`, guard two-byte writes in the default escape branch against `dst_end`, and return `-EINVAL` if `src < src_end` after filling the destination buffer.", "kind": "FinishAction"}
